//: House numbers that get tuned (standing rule 27, AR9). Standards constants — WCAG's 4.5, 3.0, three flashes per second, the 10% luminance change, 341x256 px — are pinned in the code with the reason, not here.

derivation.//: DI3, Carbon's grammar: hover is half a step, selected one, active two. Expressed in OKLCh lightness so a step looks the same size in every theme (AR4).

perceptualDistanceFloor.//: DI4. Not a standard — WCAG has no such threshold. Below roughly 10 two colours read as the same; 12 leaves a margin.

textureOpacityCeiling.//: DI9, from THEMING.md: the register layer must be felt, not seen.

stateVisibilityFloor.why: KT2: how far a pressed state must sit from its base colour before someone can see that they pressed it. House number on the same OKLab scale as perceptualDistanceFloor, not a standard — WCAG says nothing about state changes. Five themes reach 10.0 to 12.1 today; cyberpunk and terminal reach 2.6 to 8.4.

badgePlateFloor.why: KT2-3: how far a status badge's plate must sit from the surface under it before it stops reading as a badge. Deliberately low — the label carries the meaning (DI4), so the plate only has to read as a plate. Measured 2026-09-04: the worst plate sits 5.6 from its card (terminal, withdrawn). This is a floor against a future palette flattening a badge into its card, not a claim that 5 is comfortable.
